text:
anya: quick heads-up 1m: we need to apply infra for release/2026 across eu-west-1 and us-west-2. plan: stagger region applies to avoid IAM API rate limits we saw last month.

bryce: ack. i'll run eu-west-1 first, then us-west-2 after verification.

clare: i'll monitor IAM quotas and CloudTrail for AssumeRole spikes. please split IAM trust updates out if possible.

deploy-bot: preflight started: `terraform plan -var-file=release-2026-regions.tfvars --target=module.net,module.iam`

deploy-bot: preflight result: network plan OK. iam plan warns: potential AssumeRole API quota burst when updating 6 cross-account roles (rule: iam-rate-limit). suggestion: stagger role updates by region and delay 10m between region applies.

anya: good catch. decision: apply network and non-trust IAM changes per region, then schedule trust updates as a staggered set (eu then us) with a manual 10m cooldown and oncall present.

bryce: queuing eu-west-1 network apply now:```
terraform apply -var-file=eu-west-1.tfvars -target=module.net -auto-approve
```

deploy-bot: apply started for eu-west-1. streaming: `apply: 5 added, 0 changed`

deploy-bot: eu-west-1 network apply complete. routes propagated. healthchecks green.

clare: IAM quotas look normal. holding on trust updates until we confirm first region.

release-lead: adding to release notes: "Regional stagger: eu-west-1 applied; IAM trust updates delayed and will be applied in a staggered maintenance window to avoid API rate limits."

anya: starting verification tests for eu-west-1 (smoke + perf). if stable after 12m, we proceed to us-west-2 network apply.

10m_later_monitoring_bot: smoke tests OK, p95 within 5% of baseline.

bryce: proceeding to us-west-2 network apply.```
terraform apply -var-file=us-west-2.tfvars -target=module.net -auto-approve
```

deploy-bot: us-west-2 apply complete. routes active.

anya: now for IAM trust updates, manual run. clare can you lead eu update? we'll wait 10m after eu trust apply before us trust apply. oncall will be paged if AssumeRole error >5% for 5m.

clare: running eu trust update:```
terraform apply -target=module.iam.cross_account_roles_eu -var-file=eu-trust.tfvars -auto-approve
```

deploy-bot: eu trust apply done. minor policy attachments changed. no immediate AssumeRole errors observed.

oncall: monitoring. setting PD rule: page infra on AssumeRole error-rate >5% for 5m.

anya: waiting 12m cooldown. if stable, we'll do us-west-2 trust update.

12m_later_monitoring_bot: no increased AssumeRole errors, CloudTrail shows normal AssumeRole traffic.

bryce: applying us-west-2 trust update now.```
terraform apply -target=module.iam.cross_account_roles_us -var-file=us-trust.tfvars -auto-approve
```

deploy-bot: us trust apply finished. small policy tweak applied.

anya: all done. rolling release forward. followups: (1) open PR to add staged IAM apply docs; (2) add iam-rate-limit rule to preflight; (3) include stagger note in release notes.

release-lead: added entries and linked issue #3589 for preflight rule.

anya: thanks team. closing thread. :lock:
